citation: Multi-scale hydraulic graph neural networks for flood modelling. Article title identified in the repository README.
description: mSWE-GNN publishes the implementation supporting the paper Multi-scale hydraulic graph neural networks for flood modelling. The repository provides SWE-GNN and multiscale surrogate classes, training and loss functions, configuration files, testing scripts and result notebooks. Its preparation workflow converts D-HYDRO NetCDF simulations into PyTorch Geometric data and separates training and testing sets. Coverage is globally configurable at a modelled flood domain; the inspected README does not establish a universal spatial resolution or observed period. Public Python source and dependency instructions are free under MIT. A limitation is that generating the original hydraulic simulations requires installation and a licence for D-HYDRO Suite 1D2D. Reusing the linked simulation dataset avoids neither its own terms nor the need to assess surrogate transfer to a new domain. The model can accelerate flood-scenario studies and complements Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The repository links its dataset DOI and trained-result locations. No dataset or trained model was downloaded, and surrogate accuracy was not tested.
